editorial.name: Ingradients
editorial.descriptionZh: Ingradients是Gilbert Pellegrom制作的手选网格渐变素材站，可先比较预览，再查看单套下载与购买入口。免费Standard仅限个人非商业，Pro另有商用许可及数量和转交限制，模板、开源及Extended边界须依原许可核对。
editorial.descriptionEn: Ingradients by Gilbert Pellegrom offers hand-picked mesh gradient bundles, collection previews and download or purchase controls. Free Standard assets are limited to personal, non-commercial use. Purchased Pro assets permit commercial projects subject to asset-count, client-transfer and copyright-notice conditions. Extended requirements and exclusions follow the original license; downloads and purchases were not tested.
editorial.takeawayZh: 比较柔和网格渐变，为背景选配素材
editorial.noteZh: 我们先看首页柔和渐变与设计用途说明，下滚可见Soft Rainbow和Purple Haze两套预览，后者下缘裁切，未据此推断全库数量。详情显示青粉紫大图与Download入口，本次未下载或购买。免费Standard限个人非商业，已购Pro有每项目三十项上限；客户、模板、Notice和Extended边界须按完整许可另核。

reasons.statement: 精确入口交付手选网格渐变图像资产，当前首页两套实际配色预览及Soft Rainbow详情大图支持visual-assets/photos-images-textures；不是在线渐变生成器，也不把可编辑资产当程序源码。
